messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++0x code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
<perturbed_code_1>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

const ll oo = 1000 * 1000 * 1000;

ll n, a[18];
ll ans = oo;

ll f(ll n, ll ind);

int main() {
	ios :: sync_with_stdio(false);
	cin.tie(0);

	cin >> n;

	a[0] = 1;
	for (int i = 1; i < 18; i++)
		a[i] = a[i - 1] * 10 + 1;

	cout << f(n, 17) << endl;

	return 0;
}

ll f(ll m, ll ind) {
	//cerr << m << endl;
	ll tmp = (m / a[ind]) * (ind + 1);
	m %= a[ind];
	if (m == 0)
		return tmp;
	return (tmp + min( ind + 1 + f(a[ind] - m, ind - 1), f(m, ind - 1)));
}
